D: A team of supervillains is dropped onto the island of Corto Maltese on a mission that goes very wrong.
P: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.
S: the island nation of Corto Maltese
Beef mince cooked with onion, cumin and chopped olives, folded into pastry rounds, crimped and baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with chimichurri.
Polka-Dot Man and his coloured spots
Bocconcini, cherry tomatoes and basil threaded onto toothpicks, drizzled with olive oil and dots of thick balsamic.
Aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese cut into wedges, with crackers, grapes and walnuts, plenty to keep any rat happy.
M: trekking through the jungle to Jotunheim
Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, served with rice and black beans and a fresh salsa.
Harley Quinn's date at the president's palace
Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare, sliced with a red wine sauce and crispy potatoes roasted in butter.
W: Shortbread dough rolled and cut into starfish shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced pink and blue with white dots.
K: the island the squad lands on
Blended mango, coconut milk and lime over ice, with cachaça or white rum for adults.

s.note: the island nation of Corto Maltese
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion and a teaspoon of cumin, then stir in chopped green olives. Cut shortcrust into rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz parsley with garlic, vinegar and oil for chimichurri.

s.note: Polka-Dot Man and his coloured spots
s.how: Thread bocconcini, cherry tomatoes and basil leaves onto toothpicks. Lay on a white platter and drizzle with olive oil. Reduce balsamic vinegar until syrupy and dot it all over the plate in polka dots. Do not look at your mother.

m.note: trekking through the jungle to Jotunheim
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and salt for an hour. Grill until charred. Serve with long grain rice, warm black beans and a quick fresh salsa of tomato, onion and lime.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar, then mix in 350g flour. Roll out and cut into starfish shapes. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, then ice pink and blue with icing sugar and colouring, and pipe little white dots along each arm.

d.note: the island the squad lands on
d.how: Blend 2 mangoes, 200ml coconut milk, the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp sugar and 2 cups ice until smooth. Pour into 4 glasses, adding 30ml white rum to adult glasses.
